title: Cremation Just Passed Burial In America
source: Cremation Association of North America (CANA) historical rate data: 6% in 1975, 10% in 1981, 19.6% in 1995, 26.2% in 2001. National Funeral Directors Association (NFDA) Cremation and Burial Report: cremation 48.5% / burial 45.4% in 2015 (the first year cremation edged past burial nationally), and a projected 61.9% cremation / 38.1% burial in 2024. 2020 figures (56% cremation / ~40% burial) are NFDA's own trend-line estimate for that year. Burial-share figures for 1975/1995/2001/2020 are the remainder after cremation and a small 'other' disposition share, so they are approximate.
